title: Kolding School Anchor — HANSENBERG Designia / Mediegrafiker
status: institution and programme identified / exact enrollment year still under reconstruction
subject: Thomas / the Son

identity.correction: The biographical school was HANSENBERG Designia and the programme was mediegrafiker, not Designskolen Kolding at Ågade 10.

direct_recollection_2026_09_12.school_identification: When shown the recovered Designia/HANSENBERG identification, the user confirmed that this was the school.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.programme_identification: The user identifies the programme as mediegrafiker.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.admission_task: To apply, Thomas remembers being given a creative test using coloured cardstock/paper to construct a collage-style circus poster. He assembled the physical poster and mailed it to the school, after which he was accepted.
academic_performance: A in Microsoft Office / Excel / Word
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.performance_interpretation: The education was not remembered as academically difficult. Thomas remembers being competent at the work; later withdrawal was associated with boredom, the draining office/cubicle environment and disillusionment with that career path rather than inability to perform the coursework.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.chronology_note: The later office/internship disillusionment may have occurred years after entry and must not be compressed into the school-start event until dated more precisely.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.egypt_relative_to_louise: Thomas and Louise were already together when the Egypt trip occurred.
direct_recollection_2026_09_12.internship_relative_to_louise: Thomas and Louise were still together during the draining office/cubicle internship.

public_historical_evidence.evidence: HANSENBERG's institutional history records the 2007 HANSENBERG name change and operation through five branch schools, providing historical context for Designia as a branch-school identity in the relevant period.
HANSENBERG's institutional history confirms active EUD provision in the relevant period. This establishes institutional continuity but does not identify Thomas personally.

A surviving HANSENBERG course listing explicitly names 'designia afd. for medie og grafik' at C.F. Tietgensvej 11 and describes mediegrafiker/grafisk tekniker work, graphical software, photo processing, image/text, and print/electronic communication.
HANSENBERG material from the period lists Designia offerings including mediegrafiker, grafisk tekniker, webintegrator and multimedia-related education.

HANSENBERG still teaches mediegrafiker in Kolding and describes the training as visual communication, graphic design, typography, image processing, print and digital production. This supports programme continuity only; current admission structure must not be projected backward onto 2008–2010 without historical evidence.

chronology_effect.known_order: painter → meatpacking → job search → Copenhagen interview → hired on the spot → rapid move to Copenhagen → firing → return to Haderslev → nursing home → own Haderslev apartment → Designia/mediegrafiker application via mailed circus-poster test → acceptance → summer move to Kolding/dormitory → driver's licence in Kolding → Louise relationship → Egypt trip and office/cubicle internship both within the Louise relationship period → breakup → 2011 Tree corridor
chronology_effect.egypt_constraint: Egypt is now constrained to after meeting Louise. It may have occurred while Thomas was still enrolled at Designia or later, but not before Kolding and not before Louise.
chronology_effect.internship_constraint: The office/cubicle internship occurred while Thomas and Louise were still together, so it precedes their breakup and belongs inside the Designia/Louise corridor.
chronology_effect.date_constraint: Designia and mediegrafiker were operating in the relevant 2008–2010 period. The exact personal intake year remains unresolved.
chronology_effect.admission_clue_value: The mailed physical circus-poster collage is a distinctive historical-admission clue. If an archived Designia mediegrafiker admissions brochure or task sheet is recovered, it may identify the relevant intake year more precisely.

highest_value_remaining_questions: Did the Egypt trip happen before or after the office/cubicle internship?
Was the office/cubicle placement a formal Designia mediegrafiker internship/praktik while Thomas was still enrolled?
Did Thomas leave Designia before or after the breakup with Louise?
do_not_infer: Do not equate HANSENBERG Designia with Designskolen Kolding.
Do not fix enrollment to 2008 or 2009 solely because Designia existed in both years.
Do not use the modern HANSENBERG programme structure as proof of the exact 2008–2010 structure.
Do not treat the later office/cubicle dissatisfaction as evidence that Thomas struggled academically; current recollection says the opposite.
Do not place Egypt before Kolding or before Louise.
Do not place the office/cubicle internship after the Louise breakup.
